items.title: Wasserstein convergence rate for stationary finite-state vector Markov additive functionals, allowing periodicity
items.author: R. Srikant
items.difficulty_reason: The counted theorem gives an independent quantitative vector Markov-chain CLT with the stationary asymptotic covariance and permits periodic chains. Even after standard Gaussian Stein regularity and finite-state Poisson solvability, the solution must derive a signed conditional covariance interaction, control random Hessian-weight variation without assuming independence, and perform a second Poisson cancellation while keeping constants uniform asbeta approaches1. The full local martingale derivation is retained rather than gifted as background. This linked probabilistic/analytic mechanism supports an initialH3 proposal, requiring two independent substantive opinions.
